title: New in Symfony 8.2: Lock Improvements
content:
<html><head></head><body>The Lock component provides exclusive access to shared resources through many
stores: files, semaphores, Redis, databases, etc. Symfony 8.2 added a
#[Lock] attribute for controllers and also improves the stores themselves,
focusing on database advisory locks:…</body></html>
author: Javier Eguiluz
